meta.name: add-resend
meta.description: Add Resend (email) channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.tagline: 在聊天应用中接入邮件发送渠道
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果要在应用里加邮件通知能力
copy.tagline_en: Add email sending to your chat app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add email notifications to your app

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会从 channels 分支拷入 Resend 邮件适配器、注册并安装依赖、构建并跑测试;也会让你填 Resend 密钥,把你设为 owner 并发出第一封 hello 邮件。
howto.when: 当你想给 NanoClaw 接入 Resend 邮件渠道,或在 /setup 流程中走到这一步时触发。

say.text: 给这个项目加上 Resend 邮件渠道。
say.note: 会拷入适配器、注册、装依赖并跑注册测试。

say.text: 帮我把 RESEND_API_KEY 和发件地址写进 .env。
say.note: 会逐项询问密钥、发件地址和显示名。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Resend email adapter from the channels branch, registers it, installs the pinned dependency, then builds and runs the registration test. It also prompts for your Resend credentials and sends you a hello email.
howto.when_en: Use when you want to add a Resend email channel to NanoClaw, or when the /setup flow reaches this step.

say_en.text: Add the Resend email channel to this project.
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, registers it, installs deps, builds and tests.

say_en.text: My address is you@example.com - have the default agent answer my email.
say_en.note: Wires you as owner and sends a hello email.

say_en.text: Write RESEND_API_KEY and my sending address into .env.
say_en.note: Asks for the API key, from-address and display name.
